test_title: PYST 22: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 08 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: A, B, C, R, S, T and U are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre of the table. R is the immediate neighbour of both C and T. T sits third to the left of U. B sits to the immediate left of U. S is not an immediate neighbour of T. Who sits second to the right of A?
solution:
**Given: **A, B, C, R, S, T and U are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre of the table.

1. T sits third to the left of U.

2. B sits to the immediate left of U.

3. S is not an immediate neighbour of T.

4. R is the immediate neighbour of both C and T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4eba118b259a40289b3c873c1a31896bf5a14da720ffde5eb1f517ffd053b54d.png] 

A, the only person left will occupy the vacant position.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a8636d785a2b40e551ca9d65c46fea094aa1034a5f1f5c9e79865364656cfb22.png] 

Thus, U sits second to the right of A.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
